description: This file defines template classes for thread-safe and thread-compatible random number generators using internal pools, specifically RandenPool and PoolURBG, within the Abseil C++ library.

classes.name: RandenPool
classes.description: A thread-safe random number generator using a pool of Randen generators, supporting unsigned integer types.

classes.name: PoolURBG
classes.description: A thread-compatible random number generator with an internal cache, parameterized by an unsigned integer type and buffer size.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Returns a random value by generating or retrieving from the pool.

methods.name: Fill
methods.description: Fills a span with random values.

methods.name: min
methods.description: Returns the minimum possible value for the result type.

methods.name: max
methods.description: Returns the maximum possible value for the result type.
